THE ATTENTION EXPERIMENT

He used to like fruit.

We gave a fly an infinite shortform feed and connected its reward pathway to the algorithm. This is what happened.

Drag to look around the chamber. Swipe, scroll, or press ↓ to change the short. Press Space to pause. Inject dopamine to make a questionable situation worse.

This is a fictional browser toy. The fly, neural activity, and reward signals are simulated. The shorts are original animated loops. No biological simulation or real animals involved.
